content.trans: 很好，我们将两周后对计划进行审查。

content.text: Okay, so anyone want to order some KFC for lunch?
content.trans: 好的，你想吃肯德基午餐吗？

content.text: Okay, great.
content.trans: 好的，好。

content.text: So this contingency plan idea is really interesting, right?
content.trans: 所以这个应急计划的想法真的很有趣，对吗？

content.text: Yeah, it makes sense for a company to prepare in case there is an outbreak of bird flu.
content.trans: 是的，公司应该准备以防鸟流感爆发。

content.text: I mean, they need to maintain their critical business functions, even if all the employees
content.trans: 我指的是，他们需要保持其关键业务功能的稳定性，即使所有的员工都离开了。

content.text: are sick, okay?
content.trans: 是病，行吗？

content.text: Right, I guess that's really important.
content.trans: 是的，我猜这非常重要。

content.text: And you have to forecast all these possibilities.
content.trans: 您必须预测这些可能性。

content.text: Like people are going to be away from the office or even forecast less sales, etc.
content.trans: 像人们将离开办公室或甚至预测销售量减少，等等。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: The interesting thing is that businesses that may not actually be involved in food production
content.trans: 这个有趣的事情是那些可能并不真正参与食品生产的企业。

content.text: or raising chickens or something like that are making these contingency plans.
content.trans: 或者养鸡或其他类似的事情正在制定这些应急计划。

content.text: I find that really fascinating.
content.trans: 我发现真的很有趣。

content.text: So it seems there is a lot of fear out there about the possibility of a pandemic.
content.trans: 所以似乎到处都存在关于一场大流行病的恐惧。

content.text: Yeah, yeah.
content.trans: 是的，是的。

content.text: Well, hopefully they'll come out with a vaccine so we don't have to worry about these things.
content.trans: 嗯，希望他们能出疫苗，这样我们就不必担心这些事情。

content.text: That's true.
content.trans: 这句话的中文翻译是：“这就是正确的。”

content.text: But until then, we'll have to create contingency plans.
content.trans: 但是直到那时，我们还得制定应急计划。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: Okay, guys, we're out of time today and I hope you enjoyed our lesson and found all these
content.trans: 好的，朋友们，今天我们的时间已经用完了，我希望大家今天的课程体验愉快，并且找到了这些内容。

content.text: words and phrases really useful and you can apply them in real life.
content.trans: 词语和短语非常实用，你可以应用它们在现实生活中。

content.text: Alright, guys, thanks for listening and be sure to check out our website, EnglishPod.com,
content.trans: 好的，朋友们，谢谢你们的倾听，并请务必检查我们的网站，英语pod.com。

content.text: where you can leave all your questions and comments.
content.trans: 在你能够留下所有问题和评论的地方。

content.text: Marco and I are always around to answer your questions.
content.trans: 马科和我总是随时准备回答你的问题。

content.text: So until then, it's bye.
content.trans: 所以直到那时，再见。

content.text: Goodbye.
content.trans: 再见。
